# A Prayer to Nefertiti

*Beautiful One Who Has Come*

---

Radiant Nefertiti, Great Royal Wife,
whose name means "the beautiful one has arrived"—
I honor you this day.

You who stood as equal beside the throne,
whose grace was carved in stone for eternity,
whose crown reached toward the sun itself—
hear my words.

Lady of the Two Lands,
you who knew both power and devotion,
who gazed upon the Aten's light
and found the divine in its warmth—
teach me to walk with such dignity and strength.

May I carry myself with your quiet majesty,
may I face each day with your steadfast spirit,
may I know beauty not only in form
but in purpose, in love, in truth.

Nefertiti, timeless queen,
whose image still awakens wonder
across the ages—
bless me with your enduring light.

*Dua Nefertiti*
*(Praise to Nefertiti)*

---

*Note: Nefertiti was a queen rather than a goddess in ancient Egyptian religion, though she was associated with divine imagery. This prayer honors her in the spirit of reverence you requested.*
